name: patient_has_finding_of_clostridium_difficile_diarrhea_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has Clostridium difficile-associated diarrhea at the time of enrollment.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has Clostridium difficile-associated diarrhea at the time of enrollment.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have Clostridium difficile-associated diarrhea at the time of enrollment.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has Clostridium difficile-associated diarrhea at the time of enrollment.

name: patient_has_childbearing_potential_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has the biological potential to become pregnant.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently biologically capable of becoming pregnant (i.e., is a woman of childbearing potential).
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently biologically capable of becoming pregnant (e.g., postmenopausal, prepubertal, or has undergone sterilization).
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's childbearing potential status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_is_pregnant_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently pregnant.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently pregnant as determined by a positive pregnancy test or clinical assessment.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not pregnant as determined by a negative pregnancy test or clinical assessment.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current pregnancy status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: serum_pregnancy_test_result_value_recorded_now_withunit_milli_international_units_per_milliliter
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's most recent serum pregnancy test (hCG) result, recorded now, in mIU/mL.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's most recent serum pregnancy test (hCG) result, recorded now, is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the patient's most recent serum pregnancy test (hCG) result, recorded now, in mIU/mL.
